an4.242:1.1: Sappurisaṃ bhikkhave nissāya cattaro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā. Katame cattāro? Ariyena sīlena vaḍḍhati, ariyena samādhinā vaḍḍhati, ariyāya paññāya vaḍḍhati, ariyāya vimuttiyā vaḍḍhati. Sappurisaṃ nissāya ime cattāro ānisaṃsā pātikaṅkhā ti. [Kamma]1vaggo catuttho.
an4.242:2.0: [Uddānaṃ: Saṅkhitta vitthāra Soṇakāyana sikhāpadaṃ ariyamaggo Bojjhaṅgaṃ sāvajjañ ceva avyāpajjhaṃ samaṇo ca sappurisānisaṃso] ti||
